application: scripts/depthn_screen_amended_verdict.py --run-binding <this file> <its sha256> applies the four adopted rule files (each pinned by sha256 in the script, their rule text unchanged) to screen-r4a3's official readout and result files. This record supplies the run they bind to (run directory, declaration sha256, readout tree commit) in place of the four files' screen-r1 run fields, and declares final_fairness_rule RULE_R3: the final-fairness amendment's VOID rule (|difference| > 5%: VOID_FAIRNESS) applies to the whole-run gate under the declared arm fairness rule RULE_R3 (scripts/depthn_fairness_final.py final --rule r3; pinned in RUN_FINAL_RULES), not to the coarse or exact alive-band gates. No run amendment is adopted or accepted. The verdict refuses to run (no verdict, not VOID) when the RULE_R3 gate counts any COMPLETE cell whose owner capture file is missing. The extension: scripts/depthn_extension_dispatch.py --run-binding <this file> <its sha256> dispatches the 2,000-cell extension when that verdict is exactly CONTINUE_TO_2000 with no amended breakage, gated as for screen-r1 but on this record's run fields and the RULE_R3 final gate (the extension entry below adopts the extension file unchanged; pinned in EXTENSION_BINDINGS).
computed_before: Nothing of screen-r4a3: this record is committed before any screen-r4a3 cell or run directory exists. No cell, latency, fairness, paired, score or outcome statistic of screen-r4a3 has been computed; its dispatch does not depend on this record. Before it: four outcome-blind pre-flights (48 games each, never scored, on seed bands disjoint from the eval cells: run 1 on the calibration band, runs 2-4 on fresh bands from battle seeds 2103402100, 2103402150 and 2103402200, a fresh first-1,000 window each; runs 1-3 failed the latency or placement gate and each failure was fixed by its identified cause, run 4 is the declared pre-flight), the r4a3 worker calibration (RAW only), the identity certificates (prepare, classify, root and peer-belief digests on 1,043 decisions; the B2 fold check; the error paths) and the priced-output identity (325 decisions on GPU; recorded requests, no live outcome). Of screen-r4a2 (still running its pre-registered extension to 2,000 pairs): its 500-pair screen readout and amended verdict were read before screen-r4a3 was decided (CONTINUE_TO_2000; known pairs +0.043 [-0.002, +0.088], conservative +0.038, harm mirror +0.046 [+0.001, +0.091], RULE_R3 ratio 1.009; recorded in screen-r4a2's note). Of its extension beyond 500 pairs only operational telemetry was read (result counts by status and arm, the UNKNOWN causes, decision-latency and server timings for the interference guard); no paired, score or outcome statistic beyond its 500-pair screen. screen-r4a3 launches before screen-r4a2's final 2,000-pair outcome is known.
